_migration_note: Repointed legacy paths to authoritative sources. nomenclature_workbook -> Nomenclature_V6.xlsm (motor-mod Attributes columns shifted R/S -> S/T to match V6 layout; ' Motor Assy' layout unchanged). price_workbook unchanged (NewRules 5-2-23 and Mod Master List live in Price Estimator, not the nomenclature workbook). attributes_constraints_workbook -> Fybroc Configuration Rev0.3.xlsx. The 'trim' sub-block was reworked to read Rev0.3 ConstraintTable4 from the compiled constraint model (Rev0.3 has no legacy per-series sheets); it now emits series-independent (SIZE, IMPELLER_TRIM) allowed pairs. The former 'series_sheets' key was removed (no longer used by any compiler).

trim._note: Reworked to read the authoritative Rev0.3 ConstraintTable4 (Alt Size + ImpellerTrim + Allowed?) from the compiled constraint model, replacing the legacy per-series-sheet size x trim matrix that Rev0.3 no longer provides. ConstraintTable4 is series-independent: allowed trims are keyed on size only, so emitted (SIZE, IMPELLER_TRIM) pairs apply to any series that offers that size.
